description_en: Queries the current status of a specified knowledge base creation task or knowledge base document append task
description_zh: 查询指定的知识库创建任务或知识库追加任务的当前状态
name: GetIndexJobStatus

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. Ensure that the knowledge base you want to operate on is in this workspace. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间 ID，请确保您要操作的知识库在此业务空间中。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The knowledge base job ID, which is the `Data.Id` returned by the SubmitIndexJob or SubmitIndexAddDocumentsJob operation
parameters.help_zh: 知识库作业任务 ID，即 SubmitIndexJob 接口或 SubmitIndexAddDocumentsJob 接口返回的`Data.Id`
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The knowledge base ID, which is the `Data.Id` returned by the CreateIndex operation
parameters.help_zh: 知识库 ID，即 CreateIndex 接口返回的`Data.Id`
parameters.name: index_id

parameters.help_en: Both the SubmitIndexJob and SubmitIndexAddDocumentsJob operations support batch file import. This operation returns the overall status of the knowledge base job (`Status`) and the import status of each file (`Document.Status`). If there are many files, use the `PageNumber` parameter for paged query. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: SubmitIndexJob 接口和 SubmitIndexAddDocumentsJob 接口均支持批量导入文件。本接口返回的字段包括知识库作业任务的总状态`Status`及各文件导入的状态`Document.Status`。若文件较多，可通过`PageNumber`参数进行分页查询。起始值为 1，默认值为 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of file import tasks to display per page in a paged query. No maximum limit. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时每页展示的文件导入任务数量。最大值不限。默认值为 10
parameters.name: page_size

Data.description_en: The data field returned by the operation

Documents.description_en: The list of files imported in this job

Status.description_en:
The file import status. Valid values:
INSERT_ERROR: Failed to import into the index.
RUNNING: Index building in progress.
DELETED: Deleted.
FINISH: Index building succeeded.
PARSE_FAILED: Parsing failed.
DOC_PARSING: Parsing in progress
Status.description_zh:
文件导入状态。可能值：
INSERT_ERROR：导入索引失败。
RUNNING：索引构建中。
DELETED：已经删除。
FINISH：索引构建成功。
PARSE_FAILED：解析失败
DOC_PARSING：解析中

Status.description_en:
The current status of the knowledge base job. Valid values:
COMPLETED: Execution succeeded.
FAILED: Execution failed.
RUNNING: Execution in progress.
PENDING: Waiting for execution
Status.description_zh:
知识库作业任务的当前状态。可能值：
COMPLETED：执行成功。
FAILED：执行失败。
RUNNING：执行中。
PENDING：等待执行

Message.example: User not authorized to operate on the specified resource.

Status.description_en: The status code returned by the operation

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功，可能值为：
true：成功。
false：失败
